privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: YSnag is designed with privacy as a core principle. This application runs entirely on your local machine and does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on external servers.
privacy.dataCollectionText: YSnag does not collect any personal data. The application operates completely offline (except for fetching video information from YouTube) and processes all data locally on your device.
privacy.noTracking: No analytics, telemetry, or tracking of any kind
privacy.localStorage: All settings and history are stored locally on your device only
privacy.noThirdParty: No data is shared with or sold to third parties
privacy.noServerStorage: No data is transmitted to or stored on our or third-party servers
privacy.localProcessingText: All video downloads and processing happen locally on your computer. Downloaded files are saved to a location you specify. Your download history is stored locally and can be cleared at any time through the app settings.
privacy.cookiesText: YSnag can optionally access your browser's YouTube cookies to download age-restricted or membership content. This feature is entirely optional and the cookie data is only used locally by yt-dlp to authenticate with YouTube. No cookie data is transmitted elsewhere.
privacy.thirdPartyServicesText: YSnag interfaces with YouTube to fetch video metadata and download content. This interaction is subject to YouTube's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. We have no control over YouTube's data practices. The application also uses yt-dlp, an open-source tool, to handle the actual download process.
privacy.yourRightsText: Since all data is stored locally on your device, you have complete control over it. You can delete your settings file and download history at any time. Uninstalling the application removes all associated data from your system.

formats.question: Which video formats are supported?
formats.answer: YSnag supports MP4, MKV, and WebM formats. MP4 is recommended for best compatibility with most devices and media players. You can change the default format in Settings.

ageRestricted.question: How do I download age-restricted videos?
ageRestricted.answer:
To download age-restricted content, you need to:
1. Log into YouTube in your browser
2. Select your browser in Settings > Browser for Cookies
3. YSnag will use your login session to access restricted content

playlists.question: Can I download entire playlists?
playlists.answer: Yes! Simply paste a playlist URL and YSnag will fetch all videos. You can then download them individually or all at once using the 'Download All' button.

quality.question: Why can't I select 4K quality?
quality.answer: 4K quality depends on what YouTube offers for each video. Some videos are only available in lower resolutions. The quality selector shows all available options for each video.

speed.question: Why is my download slow?
speed.answer: Download speed depends on your internet connection and YouTube's servers. YSnag downloads as fast as possible, but very large files (4K, long videos) naturally take longer.

storage.question: Where are my downloads saved?
storage.answer: By default, downloads are saved to your Downloads folder. You can change this location in Settings > Download Location.

cookies.question: What are browser cookies used for?
cookies.answer:
Browser cookies allow YSnag to use your YouTube login session. This is needed for:
• Age-restricted videos
• Members-only content
• Videos not available without login

Your cookies are only used locally and never sent anywhere.

private.question: Is my data private?
private.answer: Absolutely. YSnag runs 100% locally on your computer. No data is sent to external servers, no accounts are required, and your download history stays on your machine only.
